_: Hoenn's story key items (the owner's rule, 2026-10-16: what a scene hands you goes in the Bag, a keepsake with no use), as Emerald's scripts give them (pret/pokeemerald). Icons: resources/sprites/items; the pack has no Pokédex, Running Shoes or PokéNav, so those show a letter.

ho_pokedex.d: Professor Birch's Pokédex, a gift at his lab after your first battle with his kid. It records every Pokémon you see and catch.

ho_pokeballs.d: Five Poké Balls your rival gave you at Professor Birch's lab, to start filling your Pokédex.

ho_runningshoes.d: Mom's present as you set off from Littleroot Town to see your father in Petalburg City.

ho_greatball.d: The Devon researcher's thanks for saving their papers from Team Aqua in Petalburg Woods.

ho_devongoods.d: Parts for Captain Stern's submarine, taken back from Team Aqua in Rusturf Tunnel and delivered to the Oceanic Museum.

ho_letter.d: Mr. Stone's letter to his son Steven, delivered in Granite Cave.

ho_pokenav.d: The Devon Corporation's map and Trainer registry, a gift from its president, Mr. Stone.

ho_oldrod.d: A fisherman's gift on the pier at Dewford Town.

ho_itemfinder.d: Your rival's gift on Route 110. It beeps when an item is hidden nearby.

ho_meteorite.d: Professor Cozmo's Meteorite, which you took out of Team Magma's machine at the top of Mt. Chimney.

ho_gogoggles.d: Your rival's gift in Lavaridge Town. They keep the sand out of your eyes in Route 111's desert.

ho_devonscope.d: Steven's gift on Route 120. It shows Pokémon that are hiding, like the Kecleon outside the Fortree Gym.

ho_magmaemblem.d: Team Magma's emblem, dropped on Mt. Pyre's summit. It opened their hideout in Jagged Pass.

ho_ssticket.d: Mr. Briney's ticket for the S.S. Tidal, which sails from Slateport and Lilycove. It came in the mail after you became Champion.
